releases.name: NBA 2K27
releases.summary: Nothing is out of reach for Victor Wembanyama, including becoming the face of the league. The reigning Defensive Player of the Year is shattering records at an unprecedented pace, and his talent can only be described as otherworldly. The future has arrived and it’s on the cover of NBA 2K27. Caitlin Clark is changing the game with her limitless range, but it’s her will to win that’s fueled her rapid ascent from college phenom to WNBA superstar. Clark holds the all-time NCAA Division I scoring record for both men and women, is a No. 1 overall pick, Rookie of the Year, two-time All-Star, and the ultimate competitor. Take the court with NBA 2K27 Deluxe Edition and make every possession a viral highlight. He started with a dream on the South Side of Chicago, and built a legacy that inspired the world. Derrick Rose is the youngest MVP in NBA history, a three-time All-Star, an icon on and off the court, and an NBA 2K cover star. Celebrate his career with NBA 2K27 Ultra Edition and follow in his footsteps as you lead an NBA franchise.[2K Sports]

releases.name: Onimusha: Way of the Sword
releases.summary:
Fight through bloodstained battlefields of intense swordplay action. Explore the historic Japanese capital of Edo-era Kyoto, twisted by malevolent clouds of Malice. With every stage cloaked in mystery, danger and intrigue. Battle against monstrosities from the underworld known as Genma in a tale of dark fantasy.

Follow the tale of a samurai who wields the Oni Gauntlet, a mystical artifact that grants its bearer the power to slay Genma.

Through gritty, blood-soaked brawls, he searches for his reason to fight. What fate awaits at the end of his path?

releases.name: Asdivine Knot
releases.summary:
A young cleric named Verselio once devoted his life to serving the deity Treises - until the truth shattered everything he believed. 

When the divine is revealed to be a lie, faith turns into fury, and a journey of rebellion begins. Joined by a mysterious maiden, a disciplined vigilante chief, and a self-proclaimed deity, Verselio sets out across a vast fantasy world in search of answers. As their paths intertwine, each carries their own burdens, beliefs, and secrets, in a story of betrayal, redemption, and the meaning of faith in a deityless world.

Asdivine Knot is a classic turn-based JRPG that blends strategic command battles with modern systems and deep customization. Master the shared Nexus Gauge to control the flow of combat, unleash powerful Nexus Skills, and summon devastating entities to turn the tide. Explore a wide world with your fully customizable airship, craft and upgrade equipment using collected materials, and shape your adventure with side quests, crew recruitment, fishing, and puzzle dungeons. 

Packed with rich content and designed for a complete single-player experience, this is a must-play fantasy RPG for fans of traditional Japanese role-playing games.

releases.name: Fear The Timeloop
releases.summary: Sheriff James Cooper is slowly bleeding to death in an unfamiliar hospital. But the moment his life ends, everything starts over. He has fifteen minutes to break this endless cycle, uncover the truth, and find a way out before it's too late.

releases.name: Dice A Million
releases.summary: Addictive game that allows you to Pop Ballons right on your iPad screen. Want to challenge yourself? how many of the, can you pop in one minute? Power-ups system will help you to play longer!

releases.name: Order Automatica
releases.summary: THE MONSTERZ 1st project.Ninja Ultra Samba.https://vimeo.com/61946662https://vimeo.com/61946541

releases.name: Tales of Formentera
releases.summary: Lost Antz is a fun filled adventure game where you (Ant) have to roam around the dark & unknown under-ground searching for the exit portal.Collect diamonds as much as you can along the path to gain high score. Sounds easy but that's not all, you will have to get away from the angry worms that are roaming around the areas as well. Your health will be degraded once in contact with them.In order to heal, you will have to find the herbal leaves that lies around the area & consume them before its too late. To make playing experience more interesting & adventurous, you will have to dig through the dark under ground in order to see all of the above. You will encounter surprise visits from the worms & finding diamonds will be more interesting!After each successful level play, the play area will be bigger which means more diamonds & leaves to be explored while more worms to be avoided. This surely add more challenge as the level increases.But again that's not all! Diamonds, leaves & worms are located randomly around the play area each time playing. This means that if you are playing level 1 again & again, the diamonds, leaves & worms location will be different each time! This surely adds the mystery & fun while playing this game each time.What's more? If you feel that it is too difficult to gain high score, there are some cool super powers that you can utilize via in-App purchase.Super Shoes - this will boost your speed while moving around. You can get away faster from the worms for sure with this cool shoes.Super Space - this will make your path around you bigger as you move. This surely improves visibility as you can see better what's in front, left or right while moving.Super Sonic (Single or Triple) - this cool super power will enable you to shoot sonic boom in front of you & all path straight ahead will be cleared  up to the end of the road thus you can see what lies beneath! Single means you can use once per level & triple means 3 use per level. Superb!Diamond Detector - this will make diamonds around you to emerged automatically so you can see them easily while moving around thus increase your collection efficiency.Worm Detector - this will make worms around you to emerged automatically thus you can avoid them fast before they are in contacts with you!NOTES : Kindly address any technical issues or queries to info@push.my & we appreciate your comments, suggestions or bug reports. Please spare some time to rate this game in the App Store.Enjoy!

releases.name: Isle of Reveries
releases.summary: Make a pilgrimage skybound to the Isle of Reveries, where any wish can be granted. Conquer mysterious dungeons, solve puzzles, and explore a vast overworld in this retro-inspired adventure.

releases.name: Dream Cage
releases.summary:
Robert, 50 years old, has struggled with memory issues and insomnia for many years. Addicted to medication, he sometimes cannot distinguish reality from hallucinations. But the real question is - are they truly hallucinations? Or is there something else lurking beneath the surface?

Find over 25 anomalies to uncover the truth and the root of Robert's problems. Only by discovering them all will you unlock the true ending and reveal the full story. However, don’t be deceived by the apparent simplicity of the challenge. Robert’s mind hides many secrets, and these very mysteries will make your task all the more difficult.

releases.name: Fortress Merge
releases.summary: Navigate through tons of mouse traps to bring cheese back to the mouse's home! Extremely fun to play! Share your high scores on Facebook and Twitter!

releases.name: The Blood of Dawnwalker
releases.summary:
Bringing together a talented team of developers, including members of the core team behind one of the most acclaimed games of all time - The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt along with its expansions, Rebel Wolves’ first title is a dark fantasy narrative sandbox, AAA action-RPG set in medieval Europe.

This brand-new IP is aimed at mature audiences and is powered by Unreal Engine 5.

releases.name: Wiz (1985)
releases.summary: Open Face Chinese Poker with Fantasyland is the most exciting poker game you’ll ever play.  This variation of Chinese Poker is simple to learn and will have you hooked in no time.  Play multiple games online simultaneously and chat with your opponents from anywhere in the world. Experience the excitement through the 3 modes offered in this app; Practice mode where you square up against our computer opponent, Pass and Play mode where you and your friend can battle on the same device or Play With Friends where you can invite anyone in the world to play over our private and secure server!  Download now to experience the game everyone is talking about!

releases.name: Arkanoid II: Revenge of Doh
releases.summary: Koikoi is a game of Hanafuda (Japanese Playing Cards).-How to play KoikoiThrow away the card to the table into play alternately. If there is a match of the month, you can get the cards.You will be able to finish the game to get a point if your cards are flush. You are also possible to continue the game.Can not score with each other and no game.The winner is who get more points total 12 times game. -Game record will be saved automatically.

releases.name: The Conveni 2: Zenkoku Chain Tenkai da!
releases.summary: Linesweeper is puzzle similar to Minesweeper. Your aim is to create a single continuous non-intersecting loop. The numbered tiles can't be passed through. The number means how many of the 8 surrounding tiles should contain some part of the solution path.**** Linesweeper features ****# Content- 5 difficulty levels- more than 500 levels# Features- "Check" function can highlight wrong lines- option to enable automatically highlight wrong lines- Automatically indicate correct numbers- Autosave the process of unfinished levels- Record best completion time for each level# Challenge- Game Center Achievements- Try to complete as many levels as possible

releases.name: Shoe it All!
releases.summary: This is a classic 2D platformer, where you take the role of a young explorer set free in Barranco Perdido (Lost Cliff) and has to find his way out of the 7 levels that compose the game. Barranco Perdido is full of dangers and elements to navigate through: ladders, ropes, death slides, water, hazards, targets you have to shoot with your bow... and dinosaurs! There are also footprints to collect and times to beat in each level.

releases.name: AereA
releases.summary:
AereA is a music themed Action RPG in which you play as one of Great Maestro Guido's disciples and explore Aezir; a floating island that was broken into pieces. Your mission is to find and return the nine primordial instruments to restore balance and peace to the world.

You have to find your way through all parts of the scattered islands; complete quests, solve puzzles, defeat bosses and discover the truth behind the islands. Will you be able to return the nine primordial instruments?

Play as Wolff the Harp-Archer, Jacques the Cello-Knight, Jules the Lute-Mage, Claude the Trumpet-Gunner, or team up with your friends in local co-op. Collect Music Sheets to learn new skills and customize your weapons to your play style.

releases.name: Galactic Vault
releases.summary: Something has happened in the old city of Raglife. Are you prepared for this incredible journey? Who knows what lies ahead?Pick your favorite droomie and travel through beautiful scenarios to restore the peace in Raglife. Each one has its own characteristics!Enjoy a stunning and colorful world and discover its curious inhabitants in this endless experience for the whole family!

releases.name: Marsupilami 2 - Salsa Palombia
releases.summary: A strange melody has swept across Palombia… and suddenly every animal starts dancing wildly, throwing the jungle into total chaos! Behind this rhythmic madness lurks the Mummy Queen, back from the Underworld with her crew to deliver a cursed concert with devastating effects. To restore peace to the jungle, take control of the three young Marsus, each with their own signature ability. Twister shoots through the air with a turbo glide, Hope leaps forward with an energetic spinning jump, and Punch bounces with powerful force to knock aside anything in his path! Switch instantly from one Marsu to another to unleash their powers and chain together stylish moves. And for even more fun, share the adventure with a friend thanks to local co‑op mode! From the Jungle to the City, from Snowy Mountains to the mysterious Underworld…explore four enchanting worlds packed with surprises, challenges, and unique gameplay mechanics. Beyond the main adventure, take on the Flow Mode, a speed-focused challenge where you must complete a series of trials without dying to prove your skills! And for even more fun, challenge your friends in competitive dojos.

releases.name: BioEden
releases.summary:
Welcome to BioEden, a cozy management game where you will build a self-sustaining network of structures, all working in harmony to bring extinct animals back to life. As a Keeper, you have been entrusted by the Cosmic Collective to bring life back to a planet quietly waiting to be healed. 

Upon your arrival, search for debris sites scattered across the land, they are the foundation of your journey. Recycle them into resources, and use those to build the base of your network: a solar energy system to generate electricity, and a water system to distribute it across all your buildings. Connect them together, weave a network across the land, and manage the supply and demand for every structure you create.

But plan with care. Each addition to your planet consumes resources, draws on energy, and nudges pollution upward. Find the balance between creation, exploration, and restraint, to accomplish the very mission that brought you here.

releases.name: SpeedRunners 2: King of Speed
releases.summary:
SpeedRunners 2: King of Speed is a fast-paced competitive platformer and a sequel to one of the most beloved indie games of the 2010s. Pick a character of your choice from a vibrant cast of eccentric superheroes, both returning and new, and face off against your rivals in frenetic running races for up to 8 players per lobby, locally or online.

The original multiplayer gameplay formula of SpeedRunners is timeless, unofficially dubbed as the ‘Mario Kart of 2D platformers’. With the sequel, our goal is to carefully bring this unique ‘SpeedRunners feel’ into the new era without compromising on the depth and fluidity of the movement system while still keeping it easy to grasp. On top of that, King of Speed introduces vibrant high-definition graphics and improved netcode.

releases.name: Keeper
releases.summary: Twisted Tic-Tac-ToeTic-Tac-Toe with a twist!Play against a friend or take on the computer in this strategic game inspired by the classic game of Tic-Tac-Toe.In Tic-Tac-Toe the goal is to obtain a row of 3. This game takes it to the next level. Players try to make rows of 3, 4, 5, or 6 earning points with each row that they make. Players alternate turns until the board is full. At this point a winner is declared based on the number of points scored in each round. In the game, players have 2 choices. To block or to score. Which is better? That is for you to find out.

releases.name: Fight School Simulator
releases.summary: Diáriamente no jogo você terá capitulos para fazer a leitura e atividades que correspondem ao capitulo do dia. Ao fazer a leitura e realizar a atividades diárias você vai acumulando pontos, ganhando medalhas e pins com missões que você pode realizar durante o game.

releases.name: Komorebi
releases.summary: A simple but addictive game where all you need to do is guess whether the value of the next number is higher or lower than the current number.Game keeps a record of your stats and also has a number of achievements for you to try and hit.Facebook & highscores planned for update soon.

releases.name: Angeline Era
releases.summary:
Every level is hidden in plain sight in this nonlinear 3D Action-Adventure game! Travel a vast country's unmarked overworld in search of the next challenging fight, humorous encounter, or mysterious landscape. YOU decide what you discover next in this world of Fae, Humans and Angels!

The Angel's mothership, Throne, lays dormant behind a fierce storm. To reach it, unlock its secrets, and usher in the future, you must explore the land of Era and survive its trap-filled ruins, primordial forests, treacherous mountains, mines, and more! Overcome intense battles and hilarious hazards in this tale of betrayal, haunting lore, and fruitless yearning.
